title: Jeff Nippard's Push / Pull / Legs Hypertrophy Program

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Sit back and down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace your lats, chest tall, hips high, pull the slack out of the bar prior to moving it off the ground

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Tuck your chin and rib cage down, only move your hips. Use a pad

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: Take medium strides, minimize the amount you push off your rear leg

exercises.name: A1: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your quads to move the weight

exercises.name: A2: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to move the weight

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, squeeze your shoulder blades and stay firm on the bench

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Bring the dumbbell all the way down, keep your torso upright

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: Tuck your elbows at a 45° angle, lean your torso forward 15°, keep your scapulae retracted

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Flye
exercises.notes: Start externally rotated with your elbows down and out, pull your elbows (not hands) up and in while slightly internally rotating your shoulder

exercises.name: Dumbbell Isolateral Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: Use 1 dumbbell in each hand. Keep your elbows in a fixed position inline with the top of your head, press the dumbbell over your head (not in front of your face)

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Tilt the dumbbell such that your pinky comes up first

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Keep your pelvis posteriorly tilted (squeeze your glutes), cut the ROM short if you can't maintain this position

exercises.name: 1 Arm Lat Pull-in
exercises.notes: Light sets, drive elbow down and in toward side, laterally flex into the direction of pull

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.notes: Pull your elbows down and in, minimize swinging

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.notes: Initiate the movement with scapular retraction, pull to your lower chest, keep your torso motionless

exercises.name: Machine High Row
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your lats

exercises.name: Seated Face Pull
exercises.notes: Pull your elbows up and out, retract your scapulae

exercises.name: A1: Reverse Grip EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Arch the bar "out", not "up". Focus on squeezing your forearms

exercises.name: A2: Supinated EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Arch the bar "out", not "up". Focus on squeezing your biceps

exercises.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your biceps to move the weight

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace your lats, chest tall, hips high, pull the slack out of the bar prior to moving it off the ground

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.notes: Sit down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally

exercises.name: Cable Pull Through
exercises.notes: Focus on anteriorly tilting your pelvis during the eccentric, posteriorly during the concentric

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Press
exercises.notes: High foot placement

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Start with your weaker leg, focus on squeezing your quads to move the weight

exercises.name: Swiss Ball Single-Leg Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Start with your weaker leg, prevent your hips from touching the ground

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Shoulder width grip, elbows down at your sides

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.notes: Squeeze your glutes to keep your torso upright, clear your head out of the way, press up and slightly back

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Press
exercises.notes: Keep your scapulae retracted and depressed

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.notes: Focus on bringing your inner elbows together - not your hands

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
exercises.notes: Stand upright, keep your elbows behind your torso

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.notes: Opposite knee to elbow, focus on flexing your spine

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull your elbows down against your sides

exercises.name: A1: Cable Seated Elbows Out Row
exercises.notes: Focus on scapular retraction, pull with your elbows up and out

exercises.name: A2: Cable Seated Row
exercises.notes: Focus on scapular retraction, pull with your elbows down and in

exercises.name: Kneeling Straight-Arm Cable Pull-Over
exercises.notes: Lean your torso at a 45° angle, focus on pulling the weight straight down, not "in"

exercises.name: Snatch Grip Barbell Shrug
exercises.notes: Use a 1.5x shoulder width grip, control the weight and "shrug up to your ears"

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Flye
exercises.notes: Focus on sweeping the weight out laterally

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
exercises.notes: Stand upright, keep your elbow behind your torso

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your biceps to move the weight

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.notes: You can do this with dumbbells or a barbell, squeeze your glutes to keep your torso stable

exercises.name: Kneeling Straight-Arm Cable Pull-Over
exercises.notes: Lean your torso at a 45° angle, focus on pulling the weight straight down, not "in"

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.notes: Sweep your arms out laterally, keep your scapulae protracted

exercises.name: A1: Dumbbell Pronated Curl
exercises.notes: Arch the dumbbell "out", not "up". Focus on squeezing your forearms

exercises.name: A2: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Arch the dumbbell "out", not "up". Focus on squeezing your forearms

exercises.name: A3: Dumbbell Supinated Curl
exercises.notes: Arch the dumbbell "out", not "up". Focus on squeezing your biceps

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace your lats, chest tall, hips high, pull the slack out of the bar prior to moving it off the ground

exercises.name: Tempo Back Squat
exercises.notes: Full 2-second lowering phase. Sit back and down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally

exercises.name: Round-Back Dumbbell 45° Hyperextension
exercises.notes: Upper back rounded, drive your hips into the pad like a hip thrust

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Sit back, start with your weaker leg

exercises.name: Enhanced-Eccentric Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Have a training partner push down on the pad during the eccentric

exercises.name: Enhanced-Eccentric Lying Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Have a training partner push down on the pad during the eccentric

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.notes: Or machine hip abduction, focus on driving your knees out

exercises.name: Tempo Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: 2-second lowering phase. Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, keep your scapulae retracted and depressed

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.notes: Start your shoulders internally rotated, gradually externally rotate them as you press up

exercises.name: Close-Grip Smith Machine Press
exercises.notes: Shoulder width grip, elbows down at your sides

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Flye
exercises.notes: Start externally rotated with your elbows down and out, pull your elbows (not hands) up and in while slightly internally rotating your shoulder

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: Protract your shoulders, keep your elbows inline with your head, only move at the elbow joint

exercises.name: Egyptian Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Lean away from the cable, focus on squeezing your delts

exercises.name: Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.notes: Focus on stretching your triceps at the bottom of the movement

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Focus on flexing your spine

exercises.name: 1 Arm Lat Pull-in
exercises.notes: Light sets, drive elbow down and in toward side, laterally flex into the direction of pull

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.notes: Add weight or use assistance as needed

exercises.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Brace with your non-working arm, pull your arms back at your sides

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row w/ Band
exercises.notes: See Science Applied YT series for video on this

exercises.name: Low-to-High Reverse Flye
exercises.notes: This is a cross between a shrug, a row, and a reverse cable fly - scapular retraction & upward rotation, abduction of the humerus

exercises.name: Rope Upright Row
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing the upper traps at the top and initiating the movement "out"

exercises.name: Dumbbell Supinated Curl
exercises.notes: Think about driving your pinky to your lateral delt

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.notes: Brace your chest against an incline bench, curl with your elbows slightly in front of you

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Sit back and down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Focus on keeping your spine neutral, anterior pelvic tilt during the eccentric

exercises.name: Pause Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: 3-second pause. Tuck your chin and rib cage down, only move your hips. Use a pad

exercises.name: Slow Eccentric Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: 3-second lowering phase. Sit down, knees out, torso upright

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to move the weight

exercises.name: Cable Rope Pullthrough

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise

Back Squat: Leg press + 15 reps of back extensions
Standing Calf Raise: Any calf raise with your knee in the extended position
Pause Barbell Hip Thrust: Pause leg extension machine hip thrust
Tempo Standing Calf Raise: Any calf raise with your knee in the extended position
Low-to-High Cable Flye: Any cable fly which feels natural
Military Press / Push Press Complex: Dumbbell shoulder press / push press complex (same thing but with dumbbells)
Triceps V-Bar Pressdown: Cable triceps pressdown (no attachment on the cable)
Machine High Row: Row off of pulldown machine (lean torso back at a 45° angle)
Single-Arm Cable Curl: Whichever bicep curl which you feel the most
Hammer Curl: Whichever hammer-style bicep curl which you feel the most
